explication: Dify-Sandbox is a multi-tenant service for executing submitted code in a restricted environment. Its main workflow accepts an authenticated run request, dispatches it to a language-specific execution path, captures process output and returns an execution result; the tree also shows dependency management and syscall sandboxing as separate capabilities. The sampled router and output-capture code support those boundaries, but the run controller and language-specific service/runner implementations were not sampled, so their internal call wiring is left unspecified.
